relation.note: Maternal uncle (khāl); the subject is his sister's son. Identified with the full biography AIND-D10439 (al-Amīr al-Jamāl Abū al-Maḥāsin Yūsuf b. Aḥmad al-ʿUthmānī al-Bīrī al-Ustādār, b. 752 at al-Bīra, arrested Jumādā 811). The provisional TMP-P-000384 (جمال الدين الاستادار) is consolidated into AIND-D10439. NB: distinct from the other Jamāl al-Dīn al-Ustādār, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad (cf. nisba entry D11573).
Brother Ḥamza (الآتي) = AIND-D02791, likewise a sister's son of al-Jamāl al-Bīrī al-Ustādār, strangled with the family in Rabīʿ al-Ākhir 814 H.

event.desc: Was among those whose property was confiscated during his ordeal with his relatives and family, and was strangled in Rabīʿ al-Ākhir 814 H.

person.note: アフマド。ジャマール・アッ＝ディーン（アル＝ビーリー）・アル＝ウスターダールの姉妹の息子であり、後述するハムザ（＝AIND-D02791）の兄弟。814年ラビーウ・アル＝アーヒル月に、親族や一族と共に苦難に遭って財産を没収された者の一人であり、絞殺された。

Aḥmad, the son of the sister of Jamāl al-Dīn (al-Bīrī) al-Ustādār, and brother of the forthcoming Ḥamza (= AIND-D02791). He was among those whose property was confiscated during his ordeal with his relatives and family, and was strangled in Rabīʿ al-Ākhir 814 H.
